pr_title: statistics: add mutex for Handle.globalMap and Handle.feedback
pr_body:
### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #29181

Problem Summary:
There exists potential data race when accessing `Handle.globalMap`/`Handle.feedback` concurrently.

### What is changed and how it works?
Add mutex for `Handle.globalMap` and `Handle.feedback` respectively. Each time we want to update `Handle.globalMap`/`Handle.feedback`, lock the mutex first.

issue_context.title: Handle has potential data race
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

`updateStatsWorker` periodically calls `(*Handle).DumpStatsDeltaToKV` and `(*Handle).UpdateStatsByLocalFeedback` and the both functions calls `(*Handle).sweepList`. In another word, `(*Handle).sweepList` may be concurrently called by different callers. `(*Handle).sweepList` calls `(*Handle).merge`, which writes `Handle.globalMap` and `Handle.feedback` without acquiring lock. Hence data race may occur. Maybe we should prevent concurrently writing `Handle.globalMap` and `Handle.feedback`.

review_comments: After this pr, the `h.mu` doesn't protect all the fields of the Handle, right?

IMHO, `h.mu` never protects all the fields of the Handle. It is only responsible for the fields in its own struct(`ctx`, `rateMap`, `pid2tid` and `schemaVersion`). `h.statsCache` has its own mutex and is not protected by `h.mu`.
